title: Last Call for MEF 2026-27: ICAI Announces Final Submission Window!
content:
# Last Call for MEF 2026-27: ICAI Announces Final Submission Window!

Ek important update hai for all Chartered Accountants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27 ke submission ke liye ek last opportunity announce ki hai.

Many members couldn't submit their MEF applications earlier, and considering those requests, ICAI has decided to reopen the portal one final time.

Here are the key details:

*   **Original Last Extended Due Date:** September 9, 2026
*   **New Last Opportunity Window:** Members can submit their MEF applications from **October 15, 2026 (Midnight) to October 16, 2026 (Midnight)**.
*   **Notification Date:** October 14, 2026

Please note, this is being provided as a final chance. Members are advised to utilize this short window to complete their submissions without fail.
